title: Kiln VFX blocks: the "vfx" section of blocks/*.json
description: Effects written from nothing: particles, a light. The same shape as the C# records. No compiler, no game data.

section.description: Effects by name. Each becomes one VFX with an id from your mod id and its name.

name.description: The block's name. Ids come from your mod id and this: keep it. A rename says "was".

block.description: One effect. It needs particles, a light, or both.

particles.description: What spawns and how it looks. At most 27 with a light, 27 without (each takes two of a VFX's 55 entries).

sound.description: A sound's name. Not played yet: counted in the budget of 10 new sounds in VFX.

cullDistance.description: Metres. Beyond this nothing is simulated or drawn. A number is the far distance; [near, far] gives both. Default [50, 75].

was.description: The block's old name: the id stays the old one, so nothing that names this effect notices the rename.

gameSpriteModule.description: A diagnostic: draw the particles with one of the game's own sprite modules, to tell a problem in the data from one in Kiln's module. It takes the first colour and size, the texture and the mesh; the rest is baked into that module.

particle.description: A particle emitter. It needs a burst or a rate.

burst.description: Particles at the start, and at each loop.

rate.description: Particles per second. At most 64 spawn per tick.

duration.description: Seconds of emission. Without it a rate runs until the effect is stopped; a burst alone needs none.

loop.description: Start again after the duration, which must be above 0.

maxCount.description: Particles alive at once. Derived when left out. The game reads it on the CPU, where the shaders can't enforce it, so it stops at 4096.

lifetime.description: Seconds a particle lives: a number or [min, max]. Default 1.

speed.description: Metres per second at spawn: a number or [min, max]. Default 1.

spread.description: Direction at spawn, around the effect's up. Default up.

spawnRadius.description: Metres: start inside a sphere this big. Default 0, at the effect's position.

gravity.description: Metres per second squared on world y: negative falls.

acceleration.description: Metres per second squared in world space, added to gravity.

spin.description: Degrees per second: a number or [min, max].

roll.description: Degrees at spawn: a number or [min, max].

size.description: Metres over the particle's life. Default 0.25. Above 64 is clamped.

alpha.description: 0 to 1 over the particle's life. Default 1.

color.description: sRGB over the particle's life. Default white.

intensity.description: Multiplies the colour, which may then exceed 1. Default 1.

texture.description: A PNG in your mod, power of two on both sides, 4 to 2048. Without one the particle is white.

linear.description: The image holds data, not colour: no sRGB. Default false.

sampler.description: How the texture repeats. Default wrap.

flipbook.description: The texture is a grid of frames.

fps.description: Frames per second. Without it the grid plays once over the particle's life.

lit.description: Take ambient and sun light through the fog volume. Default false.

mesh.description: quad faces the camera; quad-xz lies flat. Default quad.

faceCamera.description: Turn the mesh to the camera. Default: true for quad, false for others.

depthFade.description: Metres of soft fade against the scene.

emissive.description: How much the colour follows the camera's exposure correction.

light.description: One point light for the life of the effect.

lifetime.description: Seconds. Default 0: until the effect is stopped.

fadeOut.description: Seconds, at the end of the lifetime or after the effect stops.

curve.description: A number; {"linear": [start, end]}; a list of evenly spaced values; or {"keys": [[t, value], ...]}. Sampled to 8 values.

gradient.description: One colour; a list of evenly spaced colours; or {"keys": [[t, "#rrggbb"], ...]}.
